name: Project_Y: Working Title
summary:
This game can be played in English or Japanese.
Audio is in Japanese, and the interface text and subtitles are available in English and Japanese.


— The terror comes for those who watch. — 

This is a true ghost story as told by a person known only as “Y”.
It centers on a series of interviews conducted to discover the truth about a “listen-at-your-own-risk urban legend.”
It is said that anyone who hears the legend will be cursed.
And a “malevolent presence” seems to lurk within those interviews...
